3349.title: Flying over the Gulf of Trieste
3349.summary: I first flew from the secret Sveti Primož take-off back in 2019. It is hard to say who first discovered it or tried taking off there, most likely locals. There are no emergency landing options; everything is far away.…

content.source: Prvič sem letenje iz skrivnega vzletišča Sveti Primož izvedel že leta 2019. Težko je reči, kdo ga je prvi odkril, oziroma poskusil od tam vzleteti, najverjetneje lokalci. Zasilnih pristankov niti ni, vse je daleč. Psihično moraš biti pripravljen pristajati v vodo ali v drevje. Na razgledišče s spomenikom Sveti Primož se pride iz vasi Sveti Križ, od tam se pa vidi grad Miramar in praktično celo obalo od Trsta do Tržiča.
content.translation: I first flew from the secret Sveti Primož take-off back in 2019. It is hard to say who first discovered it or tried taking off there, most likely locals. There are no emergency landing options; everything is far away. Mentally, you have to be prepared to land in the water or in the trees. The viewpoint with the Sveti Primož monument is reached from the village of Sveti Križ, and from there you can see Miramar Castle and practically the entire coast from Trieste to Tržič.

content.source: Letenje tam je bilo res sanjsko - obalno letenje je smetana ležernega pobočnega jadranja in dolgo se je mislilo da primernega terena pri nas ni. Nekaj uspešnih kaskaderskih podvigov (ne mojih) je bilo izvedenih iz klifa pri Belem Križu (Strunjan) ter eden iz Markovškega hriba malo pod Izolsko bolnico. Niso pa niti približno primerljivi z dolžino grebena, ki ga lahko na jugozahodniku surfaš od Devina do Socerba (in še naprej???)
content.translation: Flying there was truly dreamlike—coastal flying is the cream of relaxed ridge soaring, and for a long time it was thought that we had no suitable terrain for it. A few successful stunt feats (not mine) were carried out from the cliff at Beli Križ (Strunjan), and one from Markovški Hrib just below Izola hospital. But they are nowhere near comparable with the length of the ridge you can surf in a south-westerly from Duino to Socerb (and even farther???)

content.source: Svoj drugi polet nad Tržaškim zalivom sem tako ponovil več kot 4 leta kasneje, na božični dan, ne vem zakaj taka dolga pavza vmes, saj je lokacija kar blizu.
content.translation: I therefore repeated my second flight over the Gulf of Trieste more than four years later, on Christmas Day. I do not know why there was such a long break, as the location is quite close.

content.source: Tokrat sem fotkal z novim fotoaparatom Nikon Z6 II, ki sem ga dobil za nagrado za glavno zmago na National Geographic foto natečaju 2023. Body je sicer ok, brezzrcalni full frame, ima malenkost manj megapikslov kot moj Canon 6D II, za kar upam da bo odtehtala Nikonova stabilizacija. Je pa vinjetiranje na objektivu, ki je prišel zraven (Nikkor 24-70 F/4), obupno.
content.translation: This time I photographed with a new Nikon Z6 II, which I received as the prize for the overall win in the 2023 National Geographic photo competition. The body is fine, a full-frame mirrorless camera, with slightly fewer megapixels than my Canon 6D II, which I hope Nikon's stabilisation will make up for. But the vignetting on the lens that came with it (Nikkor 24–70 F/4) is awful.

content.source: Nabavil sem še adapter (Fringer), da bom montiral svoje Canon L leče na Nikon, da vidimo, kako bo to funkcioniralo.
content.translation: I also bought an adapter (Fringer) so I can mount my Canon L lenses on the Nikon and see how that works.

content.source: No, fotke od poleta so pa tukaj:
content.translation: Well, here are the photographs from the flight:

content.source: Video odlomek poleta sem objavil tudi na družbena omrežja...
content.translation: I also posted a video excerpt from the flight on social media...

content.source: Da pa še izkoristim priložnost in objavim fotke še iz 2019, ki jih takrat na blog nisem objavil.
content.translation: And I will take this opportunity to post the photographs from 2019 that I did not publish on the blog at the time.

3291.title: Aurora Borealis or SAR?
3291.summary: I rushed to photograph a heavenly barbecue fire, but by the time I arrived it was out: only a few red embers remained, the food was cold, everyone had left, and it had started raining.

content.source: V nedeljo je srednjo in delno tudi južno Evropo ponovno dosegel severni sij zaradi povišane sončne aktivnosti, ki bo predvidoma trajala še kakšni dve leti. Letos je bil severni sij v Sloveniji že viden aprila.
content.translation: On Sunday, the Northern Lights once again reached central and partly southern Europe because of increased solar activity, which is expected to last for another two years or so. This year, the Northern Lights had already been visible in Slovenia in April.

content.source: Za naše geografske širine je ta pojav zelo redek, medtem ko je na severnem polu precej pogost!
content.translation: At our latitude this phenomenon is very rare, while at the North Pole it is quite common!

content.source: Vendar ali je to, kar smo videli in fotografirali res severni sij
content.translation: But was what we saw and photographed really the Northern Lights

content.source: (aurora borealis)
content.translation: (Aurora Borealis)

content.source: ali kakšen drug pojav?
content.translation: or some other phenomenon?

content.source: Tudi sam sem šel v nedeljo v lov, tako kot mnogi - prepozno. Aurora je bila najbolj izrazita okrog 18. ure, poleg tega je bil zahodni del države večinoma pokrit z gosto oblačnostjo. A vendar sem ujel zelo kratko in majhno luknjo jasnega neba, fotoaparat postavil na streho avtomobila in ga uperil v nebo. S prostim očesom nisem zaznal nič posebnega - oči se mi tudi še niso popolnoma privadile na temo - a na zaslonu sem zagledal rdečkasto-roza sij za oblakom. Ponovnega poskusa nisem dobil - jasnina neba in ura glavnega dogodka sta se mi neusmiljeno oddaljevala.
content.translation: Like many others, I went hunting for it on Sunday too—too late. The aurora was most pronounced at around 18:00, and the western part of the country was mostly covered by dense cloud. Still, I caught a very brief, small patch of clear sky, placed the camera on the roof of the car and pointed it upwards. I noticed nothing unusual with the naked eye—my eyes had not yet fully adjusted to the dark either—but on the screen I saw a reddish-pink glow behind a cloud. I did not get another attempt: the clear patch and the time of the main event were moving mercilessly farther away from me.

content.source: Malce nejevoljen sem kasneje ugotovil, da iz edinega in še to zelo slabega poskusa v resnici nisem ujel aurore, temveč SAR.
content.translation: A little annoyed, I later realised that in my only—and very poor—attempt, I had not actually captured the aurora, but SAR.

content.source: SAR je zavajujoče poimenovan kot "Stable Aurora Red", ker ni stabilen (spreminja obliko) in ni aurora. Res je rdeč, a gre za drug nebesni pojav.
content.translation: SAR is misleadingly named "Stable Aurora Red", because it is not stable (it changes shape) and it is not an aurora. It is indeed red, but it is a different celestial phenomenon.

content.source: Aurora nastane, ko nabiti delci iz sonca zadenejo zemljino atmosfero, vzbudijo atome kisika in dušika, ki zaradi tega zažarijo v zeleni ali rdeči/modri barvi. Zelena barva aurore je značilna za severni pol, v nižjih geografskih širinah je pa severni sij običajno rdečkasto-oranžen.
content.translation: An aurora forms when charged particles from the Sun strike the Earth's atmosphere and excite oxygen and nitrogen atoms, which then glow green or red/blue. The green colour of an aurora is characteristic of the North Pole, while at lower latitudes the Northern Lights are usually reddish-orange.

content.source: SAR nastane zaradi daljšega odvajanja toplote iz zemeljskih sevalnih pasovov.
content.translation: SAR forms because of prolonged heat dissipation from the Earth's radiation belts.

content.source: Poleg drugačnega vzroka nastanka je razlika med SAR in auroro tudi vizualno razpoznavna:
content.translation: Besides having a different cause, the difference between SAR and an aurora can also be recognised visually:

content.source: oblika SAR pasu je homogena, vidi se pas, ni vertikalnih komponent v obliki
content.translation: the shape of a SAR band is homogeneous; a band is visible, with no vertical components in the form of

content.source: aurora je nepravilnih oblik, ima vertikalne stebričke, izgleda kot plamen
content.translation: an aurora has irregular shapes and vertical columns, and looks like a flame

content.source: SAR žari v isti barvi - rdeči, aurora je pogosto različnih barv
content.translation: SAR glows in a single colour—red—while an aurora often has different colours

content.source: aurora je precej bolj svetla od SAR
content.translation: an aurora is considerably brighter than SAR

content.source: SAR je komaj zaznaven s prostim očesom (valovna dolžina 630 nm)
content.translation: SAR is barely detectable with the naked eye (wavelength 630 nm)

content.source: aurora se pojavlja v visokih latitudah, ob močnih sončnih aktivnostih (
content.translation: an aurora occurs at high latitudes and, during strong solar activity (

content.source: K indeks
content.translation: K index

content.source: 7+) pa tudi v srednjih
content.translation: 7+), also at middle latitudes

content.source: SAR se pojavlja v srednjih latitudah
content.translation: SAR occurs at middle latitudes

content.source: aurora hitreje spreminja obliko kot SAR, zato SAR izgleda, kot da je stabilen (se zdi, kot da se ne spreminja)
content.translation: an aurora changes shape faster than SAR, so SAR looks stable (it seems not to change)

content.source: SAR je lahko viden še en dan po aurori, če ohlajanje tako dolgo traja. SAR je lahko viden, tudi če nas aurora ne doseže, ali če aurore sploh ni!
content.translation: SAR can remain visible for a day after an aurora if the cooling lasts that long. SAR can be visible even if the aurora does not reach us, or if there is no aurora at all!

content.source: nastanek: aurora - sunki delcev iz sonca, SAR - odvajanje toplote iz magnetosfere v termosfero-ionosfero
content.translation: formation: aurora—bursts of particles from the Sun; SAR—heat dissipation from the magnetosphere into the thermosphere-ionosphere

content.source: aurora nastane v atmosferi, SAR pa precej višje - v magnetosferi na višini 400 km
content.translation: an aurora forms in the atmosphere, while SAR forms much higher—in the magnetosphere at an altitude of 400 km

content.source: Analogija:
content.translation: An analogy:

content.source: Če je aurora ogenj na plinskem gorilniku, je SAR še vroče žareče železo gorilnika, ko je plamen že ugasnjen.
content.translation: If an aurora is the flame on a gas burner, SAR is the burner's still-hot, glowing metal after the flame has gone out.

content.source: Ali:
content.translation: Or:

content.source: Hitel sem na fotografsko akcijo nebesnega ognja na žaru, a ko sem prišel, je bil ogenj že pogašen, ostalo je le še nekaj rdeče žerjavice, hrana je bila že hladna, vsi so odšli, pa še deževati je začelo 🙂
content.translation: I rushed to photograph a heavenly barbecue fire, but by the time I arrived the fire was out, only a few red embers remained, the food was already cold, everyone had left, and it had started raining too 🙂

content.source: Prvega aprila smo se šalili z lažnimi fotografijami severnega sija. Nekaj dni kasneje se je pa res pojavil. V nedeljo pa ponovno in precej bolj intenzivno. Nekaterim ga je uspelo ujeti zares, nekaterim pa ne.
content.translation: On the first of April we joked with fake photographs of the Northern Lights. A few days later they really appeared. Then on Sunday they appeared again, much more intensely. Some people managed to capture them for real, while others did not.

content.source: Bo pa verjetno še kakšna priložnost za posnetek tudi v naših krajih, če bomo imeli več sreče z vremenom.
content.translation: There will probably be another opportunity to photograph them in our area too, if we have better luck with the weather.

content.source: Zagreti astro-fotografi verjetno že poznajo razliko med SAR in auroro. Jaz je pred tem dogodkom nisem, in sem se zaradi tega naučil veliko novega.
content.translation: Keen astrophotographers probably already know the difference between SAR and an aurora. I did not before this event, and as a result I learnt a great deal.

content.source: Sličice so iz družbenih omrežjih, ena je moja. Avtorji so navedeni v podpisih fotografij, dve uspešni fotografiji aurore pa nimata podpisa, posnela sta jih Iztok Miklavčič in Aleš Rozman.
content.translation: The images are from social media; one is mine. The authors are named in the photograph captions, while two successful aurora photographs have no credit: they were taken by Iztok Miklavčič and Aleš Rozman.

content.source: Stabilna rdeča aurora
content.translation: Stable Red Aurora

content.source: (SAR)" in "
content.translation: (SAR)" and "

content.source: Severni sij
content.translation: Northern Lights

content.source: " se nanašata na različna pojava, čeprav oba vključujeta interakcije med Zemljino atmosfero in delci iz vesolja.
content.translation: " refer to different phenomena, although both involve interactions between the Earth's atmosphere and particles from space.

content.source: Severni sij (Aurora Borealis)
content.translation: Northern Lights (Aurora Borealis)

content.source: Kaj je to
content.translation: What it is

content.source: : Severni sij ali Aurora Borealis je naravni svetlobni pojav, viden na območjih z visoko geografsko širino blizu polov. Pojavi se, ko nabiti delci iz Sončevega vetra trčijo z plini v Zemljini atmosferi, kar povzroči, da ti zasvetijo.
content.translation: : The Northern Lights, or Aurora Borealis, are a natural light phenomenon visible in high-latitude areas near the poles. They occur when charged particles from the solar wind collide with gases in the Earth's atmosphere, causing them to glow.

content.source: Barve
content.translation: Colours

content.source: : Najpogostejše barve v aurorah so zelena, rumena, modra in vijolična, vendar se lahko pojavijo tudi rdeča ali rožnata, odvisno od vrste plina in višine interakcije.
content.translation: : The most common colours in auroras are green, yellow, blue and violet, but red or pink may also appear, depending on the type of gas and the altitude of the interaction.

content.source: Kje se pojavi
content.translation: Where it appears

content.source: : Najbolj je viden blizu Arktike, kot so Norveška, Švedska, Kanada in Aljaska. Južna hemisfera ima podoben pojav, imenovan Aurora Australis.
content.translation: : It is most visible near the Arctic, in places such as Norway, Sweden, Canada and Alaska. The Southern Hemisphere has a similar phenomenon called the Aurora Australis.

content.source: Narava
content.translation: Nature

content.source: : Dinamičen in spreminjajoč se pojav, kjer se oblika, svetlost in barve lahko hitro spreminjajo. Pojav je močno odvisen od Sončeve aktivnosti – močnejši so med Sončnimi nevihtami.
content.translation: : A dynamic and changing phenomenon in which the shape, brightness and colours can change rapidly. The phenomenon depends heavily on solar activity—it is stronger during solar storms.

content.source: Stabilna rdeča aurora (SAR Arc)
content.translation: Stable Red Aurora (SAR Arc)

content.source: Kaj je to
content.translation: What it is

content.source: : Stabilna rdeča aurora (SAR Arc) je specifična vrsta rdeče aurore, vendar je veliko redkejša in ima drugačne vzroke v primerjavi z običajnimi aurorami, kot je severni sij.
content.translation: : A Stable Red Aurora (SAR Arc) is a specific type of red aurora, but it is much rarer and has different causes from ordinary auroras such as the Northern Lights.

content.source: Vzrok
content.translation: Cause

content.source: : SAR nastane zaradi nizkoenergijskih delcev, ujetih v Zemljinem magnetnem polju, namesto visokenergijskih trkov delcev iz Sončevega vetra v polarnih območjih. Ta pojav se pojavlja na precej nižjih geografskih širinah kot običajne aure.
content.translation: : SAR forms because of low-energy particles trapped in the Earth's magnetic field, rather than high-energy collisions of particles from the solar wind in polar regions. This phenomenon occurs at considerably lower latitudes than ordinary auroras.

content.source: Barva
content.translation: Colour

content.source: : SAR je prepoznaven po svoji stabilni rdeči barvi, ki nastane zaradi emisije kisikovih atomov na zelo veliki višini (približno 400 km), kjer oddajajo rdečo svetlobo. Za razliko od dinamičnih sprememb severnega sija je SAR stabilen in vztrajen, pogosto se razteza na tisoče kilometrov.
content.translation: : SAR is recognisable by its stable red colour, which is produced by emissions from oxygen atoms at a very high altitude (about 400 km), where they emit red light. Unlike the dynamic changes of the Northern Lights, SAR is stable and persistent, often extending for thousands of kilometres.

content.source: Kje se pojavi
content.translation: Where it appears

content.source: : SAR je mogoče opazovati na srednjih geografskih širinah, kot so Združene države ali Evropa, med geomagnetnimi nevihtami.
content.translation: : SAR can be observed at middle latitudes, such as the United States or Europe, during geomagnetic storms.

content.source: Povzetek:
content.translation: Summary:

content.source: Severni sij (Aurora Borealis)
content.translation: Northern Lights (Aurora Borealis)

content.source: : Barvit in dinamičen pojav, ki ga povzročajo trki med Sončevimi delci in atmosfero, viden predvsem v bližini polov.
content.translation: : A colourful and dynamic phenomenon caused by collisions between solar particles and the atmosphere, visible mainly near the poles.

content.source: Stabilna rdeča aurora (SAR Arc)
content.translation: Stable Red Aurora (SAR Arc)

content.source: : Redka in stabilna rdeča avra, ki jo povzročajo nizkoenergijski delci v magnetosferi, vidna med geomagnetnimi nevihtami na nižjih geografskih širinah.
content.translation: : A rare and stable red aura caused by low-energy particles in the magnetosphere, visible during geomagnetic storms at lower latitudes.

content.source: Tu so našteti viri, po katerih sem ugotovitve povzel.
content.translation: The sources from which I summarised these findings are listed here.

content.source: Prvi april!
content.translation: April Fools' Day!

3242.title: Second Wave of Storms – Nanos
3242.summary: A new wave of storms crossed the Primorska–Notranjska region during the night of 24–25 July. The first cell, which passed over Nanos, put on a real show. The second went farther north and the lightning was no longer clearly visible from Postojna…

content.source: Nov val neviht čez Primorsko-Notranjsko nas je prešel iz noči iz 24. na 25. julij.
content.translation: A new wave of storms crossed the Primorska–Notranjska region during the night of 24–25 July.

content.source: Od tega je pravo predstavo naredila prva celica, ki je šla čez Nanos. Druga je šla malo severneje in se iz Postojne ni več dobro videlo strel, tretja je bila pa že veliko južneje, ki je šla čez Istro.
content.translation: The first cell, which passed over Nanos, put on a real show. The second went a little farther north and the lightning was no longer clearly visible from Postojna, while the third was much farther south and crossed Istria.

3135.title: To Infinity – and Beyond
3135.summary: Favourable autumn conditions in the Cerknica, Lož and Planina valleys created a true sea of fog that also poured across Ravbarkomanda towards Postojna. I used the picturesque scene for a panoramic flight above the fog…

content.source: Ugodne jesenske razmere v dolinah Cerknice, Loža in Planine so naredile pravo morje megle, ki se je čez ravbarkomando zlivala tudi na Postojno. Zelo slikovit prizor, ki sem ga izkoristil za panoramski polet nad meglo, da je nastalo nekaj lepih fotk iz vzletišča (hvala Ana) in video posnetkov.
content.translation: Favourable autumn conditions in the Cerknica, Lož and Planina valleys created a true sea of fog that also poured across Ravbarkomanda towards Postojna. It was a very picturesque scene, which I used for a panoramic flight above the fog, producing some beautiful photographs from the take-off (thank you, Ana) and video footage.

content.source: S kajakom po cerkniškem jezeru - malo drugače.
content.translation: Kayaking on Lake Cerknica—a little differently.

3054.title: Perseids – Milky Way
3054.summary: Buying a new Samyang 14mm AF full-frame lens with an f/2.8 aperture, intended for photographing the Milky Way as well as offering an extremely wide angle, made the Perseid meteor shower in mid-August a perfect excuse for a thorough test…

content.source: Z nabavo novega objektiva Samyang 14mm AF za fotoaparate s polnim formatom (full-frame) in zaslonko f/2.8, ki naj bi bil (poleg izjemno širokega kota) namenjen fotografiranju prav mlečne ceste (Milky Way), je bilo obdobje meteornega dežja (Perzeidi) v polovici avgusta ravno pravšnji izgovor za temeljito testiranje.
content.translation: Buying a new Samyang 14mm AF lens for full-frame cameras, with an f/2.8 aperture and intended specifically for photographing the Milky Way as well as offering an extremely wide angle, made the Perseid meteor shower in mid-August a perfect excuse for a thorough test.

content.source: Najprej en večer spoznavanja z opremo na Strmci
content.translation: First, an evening getting to know the equipment at Strmca

content.source: Ker je iz te razgledne točke preveč svetlobnega onesnaženja, je bilo potrebno najti boljšo lokacijo.
content.translation: Because there was too much light pollution at this viewpoint, I had to find a better location.

content.source: Rakov Škocjan je bil zadetek v polno. Inspiracijo za to posnetek sem sicer dobil, ko sem videl dela drugih fotografov, ki so ponoči slikali Rakov Škocjan, vendar sem imel dva jasna cilja: V oknu sem želel ujeti Rimsko cesto, ter fotografiji dodati več drame. Z zunanjo bliskavico, pravilnim tajmingom (s pomočjo mobilne aplikacije Stellarium) in nekaj vlage v ozračju mislim, da mi je uspelo.
content.translation: Rakov Škocjan was exactly right. I got the inspiration for this shot after seeing the work of other photographers who had photographed Rakov Škocjan at night, but I had two clear goals: I wanted to capture the Milky Way in the opening and add more drama to the photograph. With an external flash, the right timing (using the Stellarium mobile app) and some moisture in the atmosphere, I think I succeeded.

content.source: Naslednji večer, za vrhunec meteornega dežja, sva poskusila srečo pri Predjamskem gradu. Uspela je fotografija z mlečno cesto in nekaj perzeidi, vendar so bili bolj bledi in na fotografiji manj opazni, zato so tu malce bolj poudarjeni.
content.translation: The following evening, at the peak of the meteor shower, we tried our luck at Predjama Castle. We managed a photograph with the Milky Way and a few Perseids, but they were fainter and less noticeable in the photograph, so they are emphasised a little more here.

content.source: Za zaključek pa še bombardiranje iz vesolja na Počku.
content.translation: And to finish, a bombardment from space at Poček.

content.source: Problematiko Počka izpostavim vsakič, ko imam priložnost. Vojaške vaje in strelivo onesnažujejo podzemne vode na tem klasičnem kraškem terenu. Vsa voda iz tega območja se steka v Planinske Malne, ki je glavni vodni vir za Postojno. Meritve v jamah na tem območju kažejo povišano vsebovanost kovin, predvsem kadmija, bolj natančne raziskave bodo pa predvidoma potekale prihodnje leto. Mednarodne vsakoletne zračne misije tudi proizvedejo ogromno zvočnega onesnaženja in se občani vsakič počutijo, kot da so sredi vojne. Zapira se tudi že tako omejeni zračni prostor, na že tako majhnem območju. Svobodna država...
content.translation: I raise the issue of Poček whenever I have the opportunity. Military exercises and ammunition pollute the groundwater in this classic karst terrain. All the water from this area drains into Planinske Malne, the main water source for Postojna. Measurements in caves in this area show elevated levels of metals, particularly cadmium, while more detailed research is expected to take place next year. The annual international air missions also produce an enormous amount of noise pollution, and every time residents feel as though they are in the middle of a war. They also close the already restricted airspace over an already small area. A free country...

content.source: Jama se začne z 20 metrskim spustom skozi ozek jašek, gre se pa lahko še po cca 200 metrov horizontalnih rovov do vode, kjer smo videli 4 človeške ribice. Voda je bila sicer preveč trubulentna za slikanje proteusov, pa tudi ušli so po par minutah, ko smo jim z lučko posvetili.
content.translation: The cave begins with a 20-metre descent through a narrow shaft, followed by about 200 metres of horizontal passages to the water, where we saw four olms. The water was too turbulent to photograph the proteus, and they also fled after a few minutes when we shone a light on them.

2396.title: Rakiški Zatok Nature Reserve
2396.summary: A stork nests on a chimney in Rakitnik. It will probably return for years, like the one in Planina whose nest has occupied a chimney for 20 years. It chose the chimney of a farm manor or outbuilding built in…

content.source: V Rakitniku na dimniku gnezdi Štorklja. Verjetno se bo tja še leta in leta vračala, kot tista v Planini, ki ima gnezdo na dimniku že 20 let.
content.translation: A stork nests on a chimney in Rakitnik. It will probably return there for years, like the one in Planina whose nest has occupied a chimney for 20 years.

content.source: Za svoje gnezdo si je izbrala dimnik na kmečkem dvorcu oz. pristavi, ki je bil zgrajen že leta 1693. Dvorec je sestavljen iz stanovanjskega in gospodarskega poslopja. Stavba nosi številko 8, a v njej nihče ne stanuje že nekaj let. Stavba je sicer slabo vzdrževana, a vsaj streha je bila na novo prekrita leta 2000, kar bo stavbo še nekaj časa ohranilo.
content.translation: For its nest it chose a chimney on a farm manor, or outbuilding, built as early as 1693. The manor consists of a residential building and a farm building. The building is numbered 8, but nobody has lived there for several years. It is poorly maintained, although at least the roof was retiled in 2000, which will preserve the building for a while longer.

content.source: Na poplavljenem polju Rakiškega stržena pa se sicer zadržuje veliko različnih vrst čapelj, štorkelj, galebov in drugih vrst ptic, zato sem ta del šaljivo poimenoval "Naravni rezervat »Rakiški zatok«".
content.translation: Many different species of herons, storks, gulls and other birds gather on the flooded Rakiški Stržen polje, so I jokingly named this area the "Rakiški Zatok Nature Reserve".

2430.title: Cave beneath Predjama Castle
2430.summary: What a funny name. A cave beneath a castle that stands before a cave. True recursion. The Cave beneath Predjama Castle is in Predjama, beneath Predjama Castle :) Almost exactly a year after I took Matej Blatnik…

content.source: Kakšno hecno ime. Jama pod gradom, ki je pred jamo. Prava rekurzija.
content.translation: What a funny name. A cave beneath a castle that stands before a cave. True recursion.

content.source: Jama pod Predjamskim gradom se nahaja v Predjami pod Predjamskim gradom :)
content.translation: The Cave beneath Predjama Castle is in Predjama, beneath Predjama Castle :)

content.source: Skoraj natančno leto za tem, ko sem
content.translation: Almost exactly a year after I

content.source: Mateja Blatnika peljal s padalom v tandemu
content.translation: took Matej Blatnik tandem paragliding

content.source: , je on naju peljal v jamo. Poleg Postojnske jame je Predjama druga najbolj turistična jama v naši občini, vsekakor pa ne najbolj enostavna. V tej jami se turistično prodaja vodenje kot "adrenalinsko doživetje" in v njej se tudi kalijo začetki novih postojnskih jamarjev.
content.translation: , he took us into the cave. Alongside Postojna Cave, Predjama is the second most tourist-oriented cave in our municipality, but certainly not the easiest. Guided tours of this cave are sold as an "adrenaline experience", and it is also where new cavers from Postojna take their first steps.

content.source: In adrenalinsko doživetje to tudi je. Jama je blatna in spolzka. iz nje ven težko prideš suh, še težje pa čist. Do lepih kapniških dvoran je potrebno premagati kar nekaj strmih in spolzkih grebenov, tako navzgor, kot tudi navzdol, in ne veš, ali je lažje po dveh, ali po vseh štirih, ali po riti.
content.translation: And an adrenaline experience it certainly is. The cave is muddy and slippery. It is hard to come out dry, and even harder to come out clean. To reach the beautiful flowstone chambers you have to negotiate quite a few steep, slippery ridges, both up and down, and you cannot tell whether it is easier on two feet, on all fours, or on your backside.

content.source: To je bila moja prva prava jamarska izkušnja, Ana je mnogo takih imela že na faksu. Pa tudi prva resna izkušnja z jamarsko fotografijo, kjer za dobro fotografijo rabiš malo več opreme, kot samo fotoaparat, na katerem lahko odpreš zaslonko za 30 sekund.
content.translation: This was my first real caving experience; Ana had already had many of them at university. It was also my first serious experience of cave photography, where a good photograph requires a little more equipment than just a camera on which you can leave the shutter open for 30 seconds.

content.source: Pogledat smo šli potoček, ki se aktivira ob obilnem deževju.
content.translation: We went to see the stream that becomes active after heavy rain.

content.source: Predjamski sistem
content.translation: Predjama System

content.source: , kot je sicer bolj pogosto poimenovan, je bil raziskan že v dolžini preko 16 kilometrov in globino 168 metrov. Začetek raziskav je bil leta 1952, težko bi bilo reči, da je bila jama takrat odkrita, saj je za njo vedel že vsaj Erazem Predjamski. V njej se najdejo tudi podpisi iz 18. stoletja. Gre za jamo s stalnim tokom in čeprav v katastru piše da je odprta, je v resnici zaklenjena, z nadzorovanim vstopom.
content.translation: , as it is more commonly known, has already been explored for more than 16 kilometres in length and to a depth of 168 metres. Exploration began in 1952, although it would be difficult to say the cave was discovered then, since at least Erazem of Predjama already knew about it. Signatures from the 18th century can also be found inside. It is a cave with a permanent stream, and although the cave register says it is open, it is in fact locked, with controlled access.
